result.title: Decentralised Drone Swarm Formation under Silent Failures with ACO Pheromone Claims and PSO Tuning
result.comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 22 tables. Code, browser demo and raw results are included as ancillary files
result.summary: We study decentralised drone formation, without a central planner, under the conditions that make it hard: nobody knows how many drones are alive, failures are silent, radio is short-ranged and lossy, and actuation is noisy. In our controller, ant colony optimisation (ACO) allocates drones to picture positions through claims that behave as reinforced, evaporating pheromone and are gossiped between neighbours, so evaporation doubles as failure detection. A particle swarm optimisation (PSO) law flies the drones, a noise-buffered Voronoi filter keeps them apart, and PSO also tunes the controller offline. We prove that claims of destroyed drones vanish within bounded time, that conflicts between drones that exchange tables are resolved consistently, that survivors cover the picture to within a factor of two, and that drones cannot collide while their safety cells are feasible. On held-out seeds and with two tuned configurations, the controller formed the picture in 95-99% of runs in the hardest regime, restored it after a silent loss of half the swarm in 96-100% of runs at normal difficulty, transferred unchanged to eight unseen shapes and to 300 drones, and overlapped in 5 of 21,088 runs. A CBBA-style baseline that shares the evaporating claims but uses argmax without swaps was at least as reliable as ours once tuned with the same budget, and repaired faster, whereas ours generalised better to unseen shapes. The benefit thus comes from the pheromone dynamics and from tuning, not from ACO's stochastic construction or PSO's social terms. A centralised oracle is faster.

AI.brief_summary: 研究无中心规划器、通信受限且有静默失效时的无人机编队：用 ACO 信息素式 claim 经邻居 gossip 分配位置（蒸发兼作失效检测），PSO 负责飞行与离线调参，Voronoi 滤波防碰撞，并给出有界时间内 claim 消失、冲突一致、覆盖与安全的理论保证及多组实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态条目随蒸发衰减并经传播更新，从而在无显式通知时检测失效」的去中心化状态维护，以及明确指出收益来自信息素动力学与调参而非随机构造/社会项的贡献归因，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的自校验、停止与重规划信号及模块贡献分配提供类比线索，需核查其假设能否迁移。
